using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        // Helper to create a MigrateSession instance with minimal setup
        private MigrateSession CreateSession()
        {
            // We cannot instantiate MigrateSession directly because it is internal sealed partial
            // and likely has dependencies. We will use reflection or internal access if available.
            // For now, assume a parameterless constructor exists for testing or use a mock.
            // Since we cannot instantiate directly, we will test via a derived test class if possible.
            throw new NotImplementedException("Need to instantiate MigrateSession for testing");
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsError_WhenResultNotOk()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);
            session.SetClientResult("FAIL");

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange error")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsError_WhenOperationCanceledException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);
            session.SetThrowOperationCanceledException();

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange operation timed out")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsError_WhenException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);
            session.SetThrowException();

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("An error occurred during SetSlotRange")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // A testable subclass to override dependencies and simulate behaviors
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private string _result = "OK";
            private bool _throwOpCanceled;
            private bool _throwException;

            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
                // Setup other required fields or mocks as needed
            }

            public void SetClientResult(string result)
            {
                _result = result;
            }

            public void SetThrowOperationCanceledException()
            {
                _throwOpCanceled = true;
            }

            public void SetThrowException()
            {
                _throwException = true;
            }

            // Override client.SetSlotRange to simulate behavior
            protected override Task<string> SetSlotRange(byte[] stateBytes, string nodeid, object slotRanges)
            {
                if (_throwOpCanceled)
                    throw new OperationCanceledException();

                if (_throwException)
                    throw new Exception("Test exception");

                return Task.FromResult(_result);
            }

            // Override CheckConnectionAsync to always return true for simplicity
            protected override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(object client)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(true);
            }
        }
    }
}

            var session = CreateMigrateSessionWithException(new OperationCanceledException(), loggerMock);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert

                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsError_WhenException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = CreateMigrateSessionWithException(new Exception("Test exception"), loggerMock);

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("An error occurred during SetSlotRange")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper methods to create a MigrateSession with mocked client behavior
        private MigrateSession CreateMigrateSessionWithClientResult(string clientResult, Mock<ILogger> loggerMock)
        {
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var clusterSessionMock = new Mock<ClusterSession>();
            var slots = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
            var sketch = new Sketch();

            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(
                clusterSessionMock.Object,
                clusterProviderMock.Object,
                "127.0.0.1",
                6379,
                "targetNodeId",
                null,
                null,
                "sourceNodeId",
                false,
                false,
                1000,
                slots,
                sketch,
                TransferOption.SLOTS,
                loggerMock.Object,
                clientResult,
                null);

            return session;
        }

        private MigrateSession CreateMigrateSessionWithException(Exception ex, Mock<ILogger> loggerMock)
        {
            var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            var clusterSessionMock = new Mock<ClusterSession>();
            var slots = new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 };
            var sketch = new Sketch();

            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(
                clusterSessionMock.Object,
                clusterProviderMock.Object,
                "127.0.0.1",
                6379,
                "targetNodeId",
                null,
                null,
                "sourceNodeId",
                false,
                false,
                1000,
                slots,
                sketch,
                TransferOption.SLOTS,
                loggerMock.Object,
                null,
                ex);

            return session;
        }

        // A testable subclass to override dependencies and simulate behaviors
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private readonly string _clientResult;
            private readonly Exception _exceptionToThrow;
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            internal TestableMigrateSession(
                ClusterSession clusterSession,
                ClusterProvider clusterProvider,
                string targetAddress,
                int targetPort,
                string targetNodeId,
                string username,
                string passwd,
                string sourceNodeId,
                bool copyOption,
                bool replaceOption,
                int timeout,
                System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> slots,
                Sketch sketch,
                TransferOption transferOption,
                ILogger logger,
                string clientResult,
                Exception exceptionToThrow)
                : base(clusterSession, clusterProvider, targetAddress, targetPort, targetNodeId, username, passwd, sourceNodeId, copyOption, replaceOption, timeout, slots, sketch, transferOption)
            {
                _clientResult = clientResult;
                _exceptionToThrow = exceptionToThrow;
                _logger = logger;
                base.logger = logger;
            }

            protected override async Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(GarnetClientSession client)
            {
                return true;
            }

            protected override async Task<string> SetSlotRange(byte[] stateBytes, string nodeid, object slotRanges)
            {
                if (_exceptionToThrow != null)
                {
                    throw _exceptionToThrow;
                }
                return _clientResult ?? "OK";
            }
        }
    }
}

The MigrateSession class and related types are internal and sealed, making direct subclassing or instantiation in tests impossible. Also, the Roslyn refactor tool is not available to add test seams.

Given this, I cannot write direct unit tests for the TrySetSlotRangesAsync method or its logging calls because the class is inaccessible and cannot be mocked or subclassed.

If you want, I can write integration-style tests that exercise the public API of the cluster or migration components, or I can help with tests for other accessible classes.

Please advise how you want to proceed.
